purpose: An Allow header lists only safe, idempotent methods, so the dangerous-method rule must stay silent.

groundTruth.rationale: GET, HEAD, POST and OPTIONS are the methods the endpoint intends to serve; no method that can overwrite or tunnel traffic is advertised.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live target.
A negative case proves this fixture does not trigger the rule; it is not a claim that every safe response looks like this.
